import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read the supplied CSV and aggregate one revenue value per month and region.
df = pd.read_csv('/mnt/uploads/sales.csv')
grouped = df.groupby(['month', 'region'], as_index=False)['revenue'].sum()

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 5))
for region, data in grouped.groupby('region'):
    data = data.sort_values('month')
    ax.plot(data['month'], data['revenue'], marker='o', label=region)

ax.set_ylabel('Revenue (USD)')
ax.set_xlabel('Month')
ax.set_yscale('symlog')
ax.legend()
fig.tight_layout()

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read the supplied CSV and aggregate one revenue value per month and region.

grouped = df.groupby(['month', 'region'], as_index=False)['revenue'].sum()

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 5))
for region, data in grouped.groupby('region'):
    data = data.sort_values('month')
    ax.plot(data['month'], data['revenue'], marker='o', label=region)
